# Email Blocklist - Spam/Auto-Reply Patterns
# One regex pattern per line. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Patterns are matched against the sender email (case-insensitive)

# No-reply addresses
^no[-_.]?reply@
^do[-_.]?not[-_.]?reply@
^noreply-

# System/bounce addresses
^mailer[-_.]?daemon@
^postmaster@
^bounce@
^bounces?[-_.]?

# Automated notifications
^notifications?@
^alerts?@
^newsletter@
^news@
^updates?@

# Auto-generated
^auto[-_.]?confirm@
^automated@
^system@
^admin@.*\.automated

# Marketing/bulk senders
^marketing@
^promo@
^campaigns?@
